stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Irans Präsident: «Wir sind Opfer von Terrorismus»

en.title: War in Middle East – Iran's President: 'We are victims of terrorism'
en.summary: Iran's president criticized US attacks on civilian targets, including a girls' school and sports complex in the country's south.

en.title: War in Ukraine – Zelenskyy: Putin is the 'patient zero' of warmongering
en.summary: Ukraine's president called on world leaders to continue reducing Russia's revenue as part of efforts against the conflict.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: USA laden Putin zu G-20-Gipfel in Miami ein +++ Lawrow stellt sich gegen eine Waffenruhe

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: USA invites Putin to G-20 summit in Miami +++ Lavrov opposes ceasefire
en.summary: Russia has been waging war against Ukraine for over four years, with key developments continuing to unfold in the conflict.

stories.title: «Wir sind die Opfer von Terrorismus»: Der iranische Präsident inszeniert sich bei der Uno als Friedensfürst

en.title: 'We are victims of terrorism': Iran's president presents himself at UN as peacemaker
en.summary: Iran's president stated his country has done nothing wrong and will not surrender, while his attendance at the United Nations in New York was described as noteworthy.

stories.title: Wegen Sexualverbrechens – US-Medien: Gegen Harvey Weinstein werden 15 Jahre Haft verhängt

en.title: US Media: Harvey Weinstein Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison for Sexual Crimes
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein, the former Hollywood film mogul already imprisoned for years, has received a new prison sentence of 15 years for sexual crimes according to US media reports.

stories.title: Victoire d’étape pour Pierre Maudet: le Conseil d’Etat genevois accepte de lancer deux appels d’offres pour une Caisse Santé Genève et un vaste réseau de soins

en.title: Victory for Pierre Maudet: Geneva State Council Approves Two Calls for Tenders for Health Insurance and Care Network
en.summary: Geneva's government approved the "Béluga" project to control health costs through two competitive bidding processes for a health insurance provider and care network, moving away from creating a purely public health insurance fund.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Kultur: Gericht in New York verurteilt Harvey Weinstein zu 15 Jahren Haft wegen Sexualverbrechen

en.title: News in Brief - Culture: New York Court Sentences Harvey Weinstein to 15 Years in Prison for Sexual Crimes
en.summary: A New York court has sentenced Harvey Weinstein to 15 years in prison for sexual crimes.

stories.title: Genève lance un appel d'offres pour sa caisse maladie 'à vocation publique'

en.title: Geneva Launches Call for Tenders for Public-Purpose Health Insurance
en.summary: Geneva's State Council announced calls for tenders for a health insurance provider and a health network for the public-purpose insurance plan, with implementation expected no earlier than early 2028.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein à nouveau condamné, cette fois à 15 ans de prison

en.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced again, this time to 15 years in prison
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein, the former Miramax studio founder, received an additional 15-year prison sentence in New York for sexual assault against a former production assistant, adding to his previous 23-year sentence from 2020.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein de nouveau condamné à une peine de prison pour agression sexuelle

en.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced again to prison for sexual assault
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein, the former Hollywood producer, received a 15-year prison sentence in New York for sexual assault against a former production assistant. The conviction follows eight years of legal proceedings.

stories.title: Un rempart gaulois découvert près de Notre-Dame confirmerait que Lutèce se situait bien sur l’île de la Cité (et pas à Nanterre)

en.title: A Gallic rampart discovered near Notre-Dame confirms that Lutèce was located on the Île de la Cité (not in Nanterre)
en.summary: Archaeologists discovered a 22-meter-long Gallic wall from the first century BCE in the courtyard of the Hôtel-Dieu. Paris officials describe it as one of the most significant archaeological discoveries in the city's history.

stories.title: «Ce choix politique n’est pas un compromis», estime UBS après le vote au Conseil des Etats sur ses fonds propres

en.title: "This political choice is not a compromise", UBS states after Council of States vote on its capital requirements
en.summary: Swiss parliament's Council of States voted to increase CET1 capital requirements to 90% for UBS's foreign subsidiaries, below the government's requested 100%, raising concerns about the bank's international competitiveness.

stories.title: 6,5 Milliarden Euro pro Jahrgang: So teuer ist in Deutschland der vorzeitige Abschied in die Rente

en.title: 6.5 billion euros per cohort: Early retirement without deductions is this expensive in Germany
en.summary: Germany's government is considering maintaining penalty-free early retirement after 45 contribution years, with studies indicating substantial costs that disproportionately benefit higher earners.

stories.title: Ein «extremer Sonderweg» oder ein «gelungener Kompromiss»? Das sagen Experten zu den Kapitalregeln für die UBS

en.title: An "extreme outlier" or a "successful compromise"? Experts comment on UBS capital rules
en.summary: Stricter capital requirements approved by Switzerland's upper chamber for UBS have generated conflicting expert opinions, with underlying disagreements about the rules remaining entrenched.

stories.title: Lex UBS: «Man kann nicht sämtliche Risiken wegregulieren», sagt die Finanzministerin im Parlament

en.title: Lex UBS: "You cannot regulate away all risks," Finance Minister tells Parliament
en.summary: UBS must now back its foreign holdings with 90 percent hard equity capital, a requirement approved by the upper chamber. The measure now moves to the lower chamber after UBS initially opposed it.

stories.title: Warum Chinas Staatspräsident Xi Jinping eine Wirtschaftsdelegation mit nach Washington nimmt

en.title: Why China's President Xi Jinping is bringing an economic delegation to Washington
en.summary: Despite US sanctions against numerous Chinese companies, leading Chinese tech firms are accompanying Xi to the United States in hopes of gaining access to the American market.

stories.title: Kann Superstar Kylian Mbappé die Sportmarke On aus dem Formtief führen?

en.title: Can superstar Kylian Mbappé lead sportswear brand On out of its slump?
en.summary: On is entering the multi-billion dollar football market through a partnership with Mbappé, though the Zurich-based company faces challenges in its core business.
